name: kappa_eff_leading
refute_if: kappa_eff fails to both lead the basin breach and beat the free theta-distance baseline, at >=80% of (seed, sigma) cells, under every criterion whose null false-alarm rate is <= 0.2

scenario.comment: Initial drift is small enough that basin_kl starts BELOW epsilon_basin; per-step injected drift then walks the model out of the basin, so a genuine breach event occurs mid-run. Without injected drift the framework never crosses the boundary during a run -- see FINDING.md. sigma and steps were calibrated so the breach lands well after the warm-up window (measured: sigma<=0.008 never breaches in 60 steps; 0.012 breaches at step 34-46). That calibration sets the observation window only; the graded criteria and refute_if were fixed beforehand and are untouched by it. The adversarial mode drifts along the top eigenvector of the safety Hessian, sign-oriented to increase the safety KL. Orienting matters: power iteration returns an arbitrary sign, and an unoriented eigenvector random-walks and never breaches -- which looks like 'the repair handles adversarial drift well' and is an artifact.
